name: Stowage Planning Benchmark
description: A set of problem instances and evaluation criteria for the stowage planning problem, used to assess heuristics and planners for container placement and related constraints.
general_score_metric: problem-specific objective (e.g., number of relocations / total stowage cost) and feasibility rate
reputation: A recognized academic benchmark for container stowage planning used in logistics and operations research studies, with modest but steady adoption.
notes: Benchmark consists of discrete instance sets and multiple objective criteria; NP-hard problem so results depend on solver/time budget. Small-to-moderate instance sets and simulation-dependent evaluations; not an LLM benchmark.
